t: A small Bluetooth chip found in beacons, sensor tags and smartwatches.
steps: Buy the Adafruit Feather nRF52 Bluefruit LE from Adafruit for about 25 US dollars.
Plug the board into your computer with a USB cable that carries data.
Add the Adafruit nRF52 board package and pick the Feather nRF52832 board.
Open the Blink example and upload it to see the red LED flash.
Try a Bluetooth example next and look for the board in a phone app.
Move to the nRF52 DK and the nRF Connect SDK later for deeper Bluetooth work.
meta: Open Board. From $19.95. A few stores.
